summary: Energy label block for Buy Box with optional lightbox viewing.
features: Optional lightbox display for detailed viewing
shortDescription: The Energy Label block displays EU energy efficiency ratings within the Buy Box, meeting regulatory requirements for appliances and electronics. The label data is pulled from configured product attributes. An optional lightbox allows customers to view the full energy label in detail, including consumption figures and efficiency class. Required for compliance in markets where energy labeling regulations apply to the product category.
